Email `philip.mauskopf@asu.edu`, phone 480-727-2814, mail code 1504 (Tempe campus). No namesake ambiguity once Duke-historian Seymour H. Mauskopf (NSF record 9212385) is excluded. -> Use the ASU Search profile as the authoritative ID for routing/CRM.
- **One Active NSF Grant in the 2024+ Window**: NSF Award 2510233 is the only currently-active award to PI Philip D. Mauskopf dated on/after 2024-01-01; $561,949 USD to ASU, dated 7/8/2025, expiration 7/31/2028, program "Advanced Technologies & Instrumentation" (CFDA 47.049). The award explicitly funds "the education of undergraduate and PhD students". -> It is a real, recent, doctoral-supportive funding line — but does NOT itself advertise an open PhD seat (must check lab page and PI posting).
- **External Industry Role**: Since 1 June 2024 Mauskopf is Chief Science Officer at Azora (linkedin.com/company/azora-space; 5 employees, San Francisco; founded 2025; "scalable global network of modular optical ground stations for high-speed space-to-Earth connectivity"). -> Confirms his space-to-ground instrument breadth is being commercialized externally; treat Azora as context, not ASU funding.

- **No Mauskopf-Specific LinkedIn Hiring Posts**: LinkedIn profile (linkedin.com/in/philip-mauskopf-76012750) lists two jobs only (Arizona State University + Azora); no public "we are hiring" post was discoverable. -> Discovery evidence is silent; corroboration with official lab or PI statement is needed before claiming any 2026 opening is "officially open".
- **Closed/Historical Hiring Markers Spotted on SESE Page**: The Faculty Search portal URL `facultypositions.asu.edu` and the `apply.interfolio.com/179574` link return either generic landing pages or an explicit "position does not exist or has not been published" notice (Interfolio). Mark these `Closed/Historical` with the posted-on-or-after-2026-01-01 trail noted where timestamps exist. -> Do not advertise them as live; explicit "Historical" labeling avoids false opportunities in downstream CRM.
- **Namesake Disambiguation Matters**: Two senior records (Seymour H. Mauskopf, Duke, 1992 history-of-science grant; Sara/Eric Mauskopf on LinkedIn in childcare and product) were surfaced but verified NOT to be Philip D. Mauskopf. -> Always cite Philip D Mauskopf with middle initial when exporting to CRM to avoid false matches.

content.6_synthesis_cross_cutting_picture_of_the:
A single high-confidence picture emerges: **Philip D. Mauskopf is at ASU as a tenured Professor with a joint SESE+Physics appointment, runs a competitive NSF AST-funded program in optical intensity interferometry that explicitly supports PhD and undergraduate education ($561,949 from 7/8/2025 through 7/31/2028), and concurrently holds an industry-facing Chief Science Officer role at a small (5-employee) San Francisco optical-ground-station startup (Azora, since 1 June 2024).** The Beus Prize Fellowship at the Beus Center for Cosmic Foundations is the open-but-untagged pipeline through which a doctoral-stage hire could realistically flow; the Interfolio-recorded Exploration Fellowship FY26 (URL https://apply.interfolio.com/179574) returns "position ... not been published", so it should be flagged `Closed/Historical` even though the SESE listing page carried a deadline of 2/7/2026.

**Mechanism — implicit "Group-as-Fellowship-Track" model.** Unlike labs that publish a single postdoc-RA pin on a lab page, Mauskopf's pipeline appears to feed via SESE-level competitive fellowships (Beus Prize, Exploration) plus the experimental instrumentation line of NSF 2510233. The personnel acquisition surface is fellowship-bracket, not lab-bracket. **Implication:** downstream CRM tooling that expects a "Mauskopf group postdoc" keyword on a job board will silently miss the funnel; it must surface fellowships at the school level. **Recommendation:** treat any Mauskopf-specific opening claim as "unverified" until corroborated by (a) Beus Prize page confirmation, (b) the PI's lab page, or (c) an institutional news release — the data in this report does not provide that corroboration.

**Tension — Industry role versus academic time.** The CSO role at Azora (since 1 June 2024) runs in parallel to the ASU Professorship and the 3-year NSF AST grant that began 8 July 2025. *Tension:* CSO roles in private space companies absorb executive bandwidth that competes with PhD supervisory load — the NSF 2510233 abstract's explicit PhD-support claim is therefore a high-stakes programmatic commitment that persists alongside a private-sector focus. **Implication and Recommendation:** any outreach to the PI for a doctoral seat must acknowledge the Lab's industrial adjacency (Azora) when framing the research direction and the timeline readiness.

**Failure-case enumeration.** If a downstream decision-maker treats the Beus Prize Fellowship as a "Mauskopf-specific 2026 postdoc", they may apply to a cycle that selects via a panel-decision process not anchored to Mauskopf-group projects. If they treat the Exploration Fellowship URL (https://apply.interfolio.com/179574) as live because the SESE page lists it, they may chase a posting that Interfolio reports as unpublished. If they treat NSF Award 2305166 (or any pre-2024 grant) as "currently active funding", they would mistake 2024-cohort funds for current dollars — only NSF 2510233 is in window. **Mitigation:** the rule "use only API-canonical active records and Interfolio-side status messages" protects against all three failure modes.
